target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test two current or emerging constructions, two overlooked broken/off-kilter catalogue cuts, and one adjacent metric experiment. Character change is allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT 2026 / MEAKUSMA: https://meakusma.bandcamp.com/album/666ridims-2020-2026 — all fourteen listed tracks were screened. opo — ogenepop9bita3dani was retained as one of two available preview tracks from a collection explicitly researching transformation of rhythm, swing and structure, odd metres and polyrhythm; the evidence is release-level rather than exact-track.

CURRENT 2026 / Ñ: https://enie.bandcamp.com/album/029 — Santiago Canen — 029 was retained from the official exact-track description of micro-rhythmic syncopated percussion inside dub-techno/minimal-house framing.

ADJACENT / FLIPPEN DISKS: https://flippendisks.bandcamp.com/album/metaturnal-ep — all four tracks were screened. Nikos — Critter was retained from the official exact-track description of a form exploring the space between 6/8 and 4/4 metre.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / KYNANT: https://kynantrecords.bandcamp.com/album/tensal-industrialsociety — all four tracks were screened. Tensal — Intermixture was retained from the official exact-track off-kilter-rhythm and broken-beat-techno description.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / REKIDS: https://rekids.bandcamp.com/album/retroactive-part-four — all five archival tracks were screened. Sir Lord Commix — Under Seige was retained from the official exact-track description of off-kilter rhythm and an erratic, funky bass melody.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Stefan Goldmann's Alluvium, UMFANG's Riffs, Polygonia's Secret Desire, Dennis Quin's Tough Beat, Orion's Hell Scorchin', Waz-u's Prayer For Dawn and current 2026 Bandcamp/Resident Advisor windows were screened. Their evidence was either release-level, adjacent to recently explored identities, or weaker than the five ranked leads.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 48 named tracks across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–70 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. The opo lead has collection-level evidence only and must not inherit exact-track odd-meter or club-function claims.
Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, perceived pulse, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Nikos — Critter: strongest exact structural case, officially described as exploring the space between 6/8 and 4/4 metre.
2. Tensal — Intermixture: strongest overlooked broken-techno case, with an official exact off-kilter-rhythm description.
3. Santiago Canen — 029: current adjacent-world track with official micro-rhythmic syncopated-percussion evidence.
4. Sir Lord Commix — Under Seige: archival machine-funk lead with official off-kilter-rhythm and erratic-bass evidence.
5. opo — ogenepop9bita3dani: current emerging collection preview whose release-level odd-meter and polyrhythmic framing warrants exact identity resolution without a track-level behaviour claim.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.
